description: Fork of exp656 (2-head out_proj = 1.4998). Push the multi-head idea further: 6 heads (matches H=6 attention heads), n_out per head = E//6 = 64, tph=256 per head. Total tables 6*256=1536 (3x exp655/656). Total weights 6*256*64*64=6,291,456/layer = 37.75M (matches exp655/656). Bandwidth 6*256*64=98,304 writes/token (matches exp655/656). 6 disjoint slices of E concat to final E=384. Tests whether finer per-head granularity + more small tables wins over fewer larger tables. Reference: exp656 = 1.4998 (2-head), exp655 = 1.4928 (sparse 1/2), exp654 = 1.4919 (dense), exp650 = 1.4825 (with resid), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
